name: KitchenConversationsMorningRush

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a realistic solo morning kitchen conversation. A person makes coffee and breakfast while thinking aloud and briefly asking their home assistant a practical question.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Morning kitchen ambience, coffee machine brewing, toast popping, light kitchen clatter

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo morning kitchen scene. The person prepares breakfast while thinking aloud, checking the time, and asking the assistant one brief practical question.

variations.context: Solo weekday morning routine in the kitchen

setting.relationship_dynamic: Individual managing their own morning routine
setting.background: The person has a set morning routine but runs slightly late; they use the assistant for quick practical lookups
setting.conversation_style: Short self-directed statements and questions. Thinking aloud while multitasking. Efficient assistant interaction.

scenario_template.topic: Getting up, starting the coffee — immediately asks Sigma something practical: weather, time, a reminder
scenario_template.note: The Sigma question comes almost immediately — within the first or second turn. Like asking aloud while filling the kettle. 'Sigma, what's the weather today?' or 'Sigma, what time is it?' Address Sigma by name.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma answers; user processes the answer and moves into making breakfast
scenario_template.note: User acknowledges and continues. They check the fridge, decide what to make. Brief self-talk — but short, 1-2 lines maximum.

scenario_template.topic: Mentally running through the day while eating or finishing prep
scenario_template.note: Brief internal review — commitments, what to bring. Self-reminders. Short.

scenario_template.topic: Heading out — grabbing things, stepping out the door
scenario_template.note: A closing remark or two. Brief and natural.

user1.name: Joanna
user1.role: A person with a busy weekday morning routine. Functional and efficient in the kitchen but not fully awake yet. Uses the assistant as a practical tool without much ceremony.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: A home assistant that answers brief practical questions — timers, conversions, reminders, weather. Responds only when addressed by name. Keeps answers short.
